brief.industry_meta: Defence Technology · Autonomous Maritime Vessels / Shipbuilding
brief.deck: Saronic, the Austin-based builder of autonomous naval vessels, closed a $1.75B Series D led by Kleiner Perkins at a $9.25B post-money valuation on 31 March 2026, more than doubling its price in a year, with the capital pointed at shipyards: a $300M Louisiana expansion and Port Alpha, then choosing its site.
brief.the_case_p1: On 31 March 2026 Saronic announced a $1.75B Series D led by Kleiner Perkins at a $9.25B post-money valuation, with Advent International, Bessemer Venture Partners, DFJ Growth and BAM Elevate joining 8VC, Caffeinated Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Elad Gil and Franklin Templeton; a $600M Series C had valued it at $4B in 2025. In December the US Navy awarded a $392M production contract for its 24-foot Corsair, prototype to production in under 12 months. Franklin, Louisiana is adding 300,000 square feet and 1,500 jobs; Port Alpha targets 20-plus vessels a year by 2027. <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9.5'>AMERICAN SHIPBUILDING, REBUILT FROM TEXAS.</font>
brief.the_case_p2: No defence, maritime-autonomy or shipbuilding brand sits on the Formula 1 grid; the nearest adjacencies are Boeing at Alpine and Zoox at Williams, and neither conflicts. The question is not a category clash but which team's identity a US Navy supplier can stand behind. Two teams are American: one a privateer built around machine tools, the other a General Motors works entry in its first season with a manufacturing campus rising in Indiana.
brief.why_now_callout: <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9'>WHY NOW</font>  The Series D closed on 31 March and the Port Alpha site decision, with its governors and senators, is the next public act. Cadillac settles its 2027 roster between the summer break and the United States GP in Austin, Saronic's home city; a deal agreed by summer is announced at home.
brief.why_team_para: Cadillac is the American works team, in its first season with an inaugural roster: TWG AI, Claro, Core Scientific, IFS, Jim Beam, Tenneco, Tommy Hilfiger, Pirelli and Alpinestars. It has no industrial-technology, defence or autonomy partner. Its cars are engineered at Silverstone while a campus rises in Fishers, Indiana; Saronic is building Port Alpha on the same reindustrialisation story. Austin is the team's home race and Saronic's home city, and a Navy supplier belongs beside the American flag-bearer.
brief.value_content: MODE B - halo with mechanics. Saronic's constraint is people: 1,500 hires in Louisiana, 10,000 planned at Port Alpha, and autonomy engineers who could work anywhere. A Formula 1 partnership is a recruiting platform: engineer exchanges between Cadillac's simulation group and Saronic's autonomy team, campus activations around Austin, the team's manufacturing story told beside Saronic's. Cadillac gains an American industrial partner with a national-security audience for its US hospitality, and content from a shipyard building at Formula 1 pace.
brief.deal_arch_para: Entry as Official Autonomy and Shipbuilding Partner. <font name='Poppins-Bold' size='9.5'>THREE YEARS</font>, 2027-2029, through the Port Alpha build-out. Estimated $4-6M a year. Scope: sidepod placement, Austin, Miami and Las Vegas hospitality for Navy, congressional and state guests, an engineering-exchange programme, and co-produced content on building at speed.
brief.decision_maker_bio: Mavrookas, a former Navy SEAL and Vista Equity Partners investor, co-founded Saronic and fronts every raise. Path: Rob Lehman, Co-Founder and Chief Commercial Officer, who owns marketing and sales; Emily Shanklin, Chief Marketing Officer, ex-SpaceX marketing and communications lead; Patrick Depriest, CFO.
brief.opening_angle_intro: Lead with Austin and the shipyards.
brief.opening_angle_quote: “Dino, Cadillac is the American works team, and Austin is home for both of you. No defence or autonomy brand sits on the grid, and your constraint is hiring ten thousand people. 25 minutes on Formula 1 as a recruiting platform?”
score_cells: Round closed 31 Mar; Austin in October.
Sovereignty archetype; defence brand needs care.
MODE B halo; recruiting is the mechanism.
risks: A DEFENCE BRAND ON A CAR
Some teams and host markets are wary of weapons-adjacent partners.
Lead with shipbuilding, autonomy and jobs; keep Corsair's strike role out of the creative.

Make the engineering exchange and recruiting KPIs the contract's substance.
brief.bottom_line: A $1.75B Series D at $9.25B, a $392M Navy production contract and two shipyards to staff give Saronic the budget and the motive for a national platform. Cadillac is the American works team with no industrial or defence partner, and the United States GP in Austin is home for both.

why_now.label: Trigger
why_now.text: On 31 March 2026 Saronic announced a $1.75B Series D led by Kleiner Perkins at a $9.25B post-money valuation, with Advent International, Bessemer Venture Partners, DFJ Growth and BAM Elevate joining 8VC, Caffeinated Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Elad Gil and Franklin Templeton. A $600M Series C had valued the company at $4B in 2025, so the price more than doubled in about a year.

why_now.label: Production, not prototypes
why_now.text: In December 2025 the US Navy awarded Saronic a $392M production contract for the 24-foot Corsair, announced at the Reagan National Defense Forum, with the Navy Secretary citing prototype to production in under 12 months. The same month Saronic announced a $300M expansion of its Franklin, Louisiana shipyard, adding more than 300,000 square feet and 1,500 jobs, where the 180-foot Marauder is built.

why_now.label: Port Alpha
why_now.text: The Series D capital is earmarked for shipbuilding capacity: Port Alpha, a planned Texas shipyard expected to build more than 20 autonomous surface vessels a year by 2027 and create 10,000 direct jobs over a decade. On this row's date the site was still being selected; Saronic announced Brownsville, Texas, on 16 July 2026. A company choosing where to put 10,000 jobs is in a season of governors, senators and public ceremonies, which is also the audience a US Grand Prix suite holds.

why_now.label: Calendar window
why_now.text: The Miami GP ran on 3 May 2026, two days before this row. The United States GP in Austin in late October is Saronic's home race, and Cadillac settles its 2027 partner roster between the summer break and Austin. A deal agreed by July can be announced at home.

why_team.label: The open lane
why_team.text: Cadillac's 2026 roster is entirely inaugural: TWG AI, Claro, Core Scientific, IFS, Jim Beam, Tenneco, Tommy Hilfiger, Pirelli, Alpinestars and TWG Motorsports, with General Motors as parent. There is no industrial-technology, defence or autonomy partner, and no such brand on any Formula 1 roster; the nearest adjacencies, Boeing at Alpine and Zoox at Williams, do not conflict.

why_team.label: The same story
why_team.text: Cadillac is a General Motors works entry engineering its cars at Silverstone while a campus rises in Fishers, Indiana. Saronic is building Port Alpha and expanding Franklin on an American reindustrialisation narrative. Two American industrial builders in their first years, one on the car and one on the water, is a story both can tell in Washington and on Wall Street.

why_team.label: Home race
why_team.text: Saronic is headquartered in Austin. The United States GP is Cadillac's home race and the round where the team hosts its most senior American guests. A Navy supplier's congressional, state and Navy audience is the same guest list.

why_team.label: Why not Haas
why_team.text: TGR Haas is the other American team, a privateer whose parent, Haas Automation, is a machine-tool maker. It is open, but a General Motors works entry with a national profile carries a defence-industrial brand more comfortably than a privateer with a Toyota title partner, and Cadillac's roster is cleaner.

value.label: Recruiting is the workstream (Mode B)
value.text: Saronic's binding constraint is people: 1,500 new jobs in Louisiana, 10,000 at Port Alpha, and autonomy, software and manufacturing engineers who have offers from anywhere. Formula 1 is the strongest engineering-recruitment brand in sport. Engineer exchanges between Cadillac's simulation and manufacturing groups and Saronic's autonomy team, campus activations around the Austin round and a co-branded careers programme give the partnership substance a logo does not.

value.label: The audience Cadillac wants
value.text: Saronic brings Navy leadership, members of Congress, state officials and defence-industrial executives to the Austin, Miami and Las Vegas suites, an American power audience Cadillac's first-season hospitality is built to host.

value.label: Content and narrative
value.text: A shipyard turning prototypes into production in under a year beside a team building a Formula 1 operation from nothing: co-produced content on building at speed, from Franklin and Port Alpha to Fishers and Silverstone, told for both companies' recruiting and investor audiences.

value.label: What the team gives back
value.text: Official Autonomy and Shipbuilding Partner designation, sidepod placement, hospitality at the three US rounds, an engineering-exchange programme, and driver and team access for Saronic's recruiting and public-affairs channels.

ruled_out.reason: Open but not chosen: American privateer with a Toyota title partner and a machine-tool parent brand; a defence-industrial partner sits more comfortably on the GM works entry.
Boeing holds the aerospace and defence-adjacent lane.
A US Navy supplier's brand, audience and recruiting pool are American; a foreign-flag team gives it no home race and no political audience.

extended.ask: A 25-minute call with Dino Mavrookas and Rob Lehman before the summer break to test Formula 1 as a recruiting and public-affairs platform, agree an Austin announcement window, and size an entry against Cadillac's 2027 roster.

# Saronic → Cadillac F1 Team — verification log (N° 230, row dated 5 May 2026)

The thin row's trigger holds in full: the $1.75B Series D at a $9.25B post-money valuation was announced by the company on **31 Mar 2026**, 35 days before the row's date.
